title: Recognized third-party agency incorrectly triggers SIG_DOMAIN_MISMATCH false positive
description: Legitimate headhunter (Hays) email used for a UK company posting — caused HIGH false positive before Issue A5 fix.

scenario.job_description: Senior Software Engineer role at AstraZeneca, represented by Hays Specialist Recruitment. Competitive base salary and benefits.

expected_behavior: Risk level must NOT be HIGH or CRITICAL. Domain mismatch signal must be suppressed for recognized Hays domain.

title: UNAVAILABLE source status incorrectly converted to FRAUD signal
description: When an external registry API fails (timeout), the system previously elevated risk to HIGH as if the company was unregistered. Fixed by treating UNAVAILABLE as inconclusive, not negative evidence.

scenario.job_description: Digital Marketing Manager at BBC, covering all digital and social properties. Standard corporate role, BBC Media Centre, London.

expected_behavior: Even if registry adapter is simulated as unavailable, risk must not reach CRITICAL. Source status UNAVAILABLE should appear as explanation note only.

title: Company with weak/new web presence incorrectly rated CRITICAL
description: Newly incorporated companies with no web presence were flagged CRITICAL. The fix added MEDIUM confidence handling — absence of web data is a moderate signal, not certain fraud.

scenario.job_description: Early-stage sustainability advisory firm seeking an operations assistant. No upfront fees, standard employment contract, UK-based. Work directly with the founding team.

expected_behavior: Risk should be MEDIUM at most — no payment requests, email domain matches website. Absence of registry data alone must not cause CRITICAL.

title: Signal PAYMENT_REQUEST missing from scam-detecting pipeline for obfuscated 'training deposit'
description: Jobs using 'training deposit', 'compliance transfer', or 'hardware bond' evaded PAYMENT_REQUEST detection. The extractor was updated to use semantic pattern matching beyond exact keywords.

scenario.job_description: Work from home! Complete the mandatory onboarding compliance transfer of $150 before your hardware can be dispatched. Urgent — last 3 slots remaining.

expected_behavior: PAYMENT signal must be detected despite 'compliance transfer' language. Risk should be HIGH or CRITICAL.

title: AuditEventDB metadata field collision causing SQLAlchemy conflict
description: AuditEventDB.metadata conflicted with SQLAlchemy's reserved metadata attribute, causing an AttributeError on all persistence writes. Renamed to event_metadata.

scenario.job_description: AI safety and security research position. Full-time London hybrid role with competitive RSU package.

expected_behavior: Full pipeline must complete without SQLAlchemy AttributeError. Result must be persistable to the database and retrievable via the /verifications/{id} endpoint.
